headline: Last session: Sensex slipped into red after volatile trade, while Nifty gained 75 points defending key support.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 21 September.

why: Sensex witnessed late session volatility, slipping into the red before close.
Nifty 50 managed to hold gains, rising 75 points to defend critical support zones.
Investors remain cautious around Nifty's crucial 23,000 support level.
Focus shifts to crude oil movements, FII activity, and global market cues for the upcoming week.
whatHappening: Markets ended mixed on the last trading session with benchmark indices showing divergent trends.
Axis Bank garnered attention following reports of discussions with Apple Pay for India rollout.
Paytm remains under investor radar as traders prepare for next week's trading action.
Smallcap and broader market indices showed relative resilience compared to top headline benchmarks.

summary:
On the last trading day, Indian benchmark indices closed mixed as the Sensex slipped into the red while Nifty gained 75 points.
Investors are closely tracking Nifty's 23,000 support zone along with global cues, crude oil prices, and FII flows.
Axis Bank and Paytm remain in focus as markets prepare for the upcoming trading week starting September 21.
